name: Ariosophy
summary: Ariosophy is the Austro-German occult-racist current of c. 1890-1930, the Armanism of Guido von List and the Theozoology of Jörg Lanz von Liebenfels. It holds that a god-descended Aryan-Germanic elite once ruled as priest-kings and should rule again, over 'slave races' kept apart by racial laws and breeding, in a hierarchical pan-German empire. It is monarchist, anti-parliamentary, patriarchal, hostile to socialism, feminism and charity, and nostalgic for guilds and landed estates.
scope: The doctrines of List (Armanism) and Lanz (Theozoology, Ario-Christianity) before 1914, as Goodrick-Clarke defines Ariosophy. Excludes the later rune occultists, Thule Society and Nazi practice, which the sources treat as derivatives or parallel developments rather than Ariosophy's own positions.
